full_page.content:
1948, July 14
The following is a faithful photo copy of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap. , and a faithful transcription.
1948, July 14th
Bles'd be God in His angels and in His saints!
July 14, 1948
God Bless you Mrs. Francis Eggen O'Connor:
Many thanks for your kind favor of a week ago. I certainly do remember you and your folks. How fortunate you have been in the faith God has given us -- strengthening it so often by super- natural responses to prayer -- as in the case of your dear Father Earl -- with his "hopeless" cancer!
Glad to know he is well as also your little Sister Dorothy -- now V. Sister Mary Celia -- also wrote me.
I have told hundreds of your Father's case when they brought him first time to St. Bonaventure's January 10, 1925, and how he surprised us when eight days later he brought your good Mother with him driving his own car -- looking 25 years younger !. . .
Praised be Jesus!
Fr. Solanus O. F. M. Cap.
N. B. Sister Mary Cecilia Eagen wrote on this photo copy that the above date January 10, 1925, (in Fr. Solanus' hand) should have been 1935.
Original in possession of: Sister Mary Cecilia Eagen 32450 South Pierce Birmingham, Mi. 48009
